# docker_registry_image_manifests (Data Source)

Reads the manifest of an image straight from its registry, with the provider's `registry_auth`, like `docker buildx imagetools inspect` or `docker manifest inspect`. For a manifest list or OCI index every entry is listed (attestation manifests appear with platform `unknown/unknown`) and, unless `attestations = false`, each platform's image config and its SLSA provenance and SPDX SBOM attestations are read too; a single-platform image gives one entry whose platform comes from its config blob. Nothing is pulled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_registry_image_manifests" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"
}

# Pin the arm64 variant of a multi-platform tag.
locals {
  arm64 = one([for m in data.docker_registry_image_manifests.nginx.manifests : m.digest if m.os == "linux" && m.architecture == "arm64"])
}

output "nginx_arm64" {
  value = "nginx@${local.arm64}"
}

# SLSA provenance of a BuildKit-built image (null when it has none).
data "docker_registry_image_manifests" "app" {
  name = "ghcr.io/org/app:1.0"
}

output "app_provenance" {
  value     = try(jsondecode(data.docker_registry_image_manifests.app.provenance_json)["linux/amd64"].SLSA, null)
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image reference, e.g. `nginx:1.27` or `ghcr.io/org/app@sha256:...` (no tag means `latest`).

### Optional

- `attestations` (Boolean) Read the image config and the attestations of every platform of an index (two to four extra requests per platform). Default `true`; `false` reads only the top-level document, and `image_config_json`, `provenance_json` and `sbom_json` stay null for an index.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification of the registry.

### Read-Only

- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `digest` (String) Digest of the top-level manifest (index, list or image manifest).
- `image_config` (Attributes) The image config field by field (for an index: one entry per platform, keyed os/arch[/variant]). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_config))
- `image_config_json` (String, Sensitive) Image config blob (per platform for an index: a JSON object keyed by os/arch[/variant]). Sensitive: config.Env can hold baked-in secrets.
- `image_config_json_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of image_config_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `image_digest_ref` (String) Pinned reference `<registry>/<repository>@sha256:...`, safe to hand to a deploy tool.
- `image_ref` (String) Normalized reference, e.g. `docker.io/library/alpine:latest`.
- `manifest` (Attributes) The manifest/index field by field; for an index, `manifests[*].platform` gives os/architecture/variant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifest))
- `manifest_json` (String) The top-level manifest, OCI index or manifest list exactly as the registry served it.
- `manifest_json_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of manifest_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `manifests` (Attributes List) Entries of the top-level document, in registry order (one entry for a single image manifest). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifests))
- `media_type` (String) Media type of the top-level manifest.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms as `os/arch[/variant]`, in registry order, excluding attestation manifests.
- `provenance_json` (String, Sensitive) SLSA provenance attestation content; empty when the image has none. Sensitive: provenance can record build args.
- `provenance_json_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of provenance_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `sbom_json` (String) SBOM attestation content (SPDX); empty when the image has none.
- `sbom_json_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of sbom_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.

<a id="nestedatt--manifests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manifests`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture, e.g. `amd64` or `arm64`.
- `digest` (String) Manifest digest; pin a platform with `<repo>@<digest>`.
- `media_type` (String) Manifest media type.
- `os` (String) Operating system, e.g. `linux`.
- `os_version` (String) OS version (Windows images); empty when none.
- `size` (Number) Manifest size in bytes.
- `variant` (String) CPU variant, e.g. `v8`; empty when none.
